datasets.name: ds_desempenho
queryLines: WITH champ AS (SELECT model_version FROM gold_desempenho_modelo WHERE gate_status = 'aprovado' ORDER BY avaliado_em DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT CONCAT('v', d.model_version) AS modelo, ROUND(d.auc, 3) AS auc, ROUND(d.ks, 3) AS ks,
ROUND(d.pr_auc, 3) AS pr_auc, ROUND(d.recall, 3) AS recall, ROUND(d.precision, 3) AS precisao,
ROUND(d.pct_reprovados, 3) AS pct_reprovados, ROUND(d.threshold, 3) AS threshold, d.gate_status,
d.n_teste FROM gold_desempenho_modelo d JOIN champ USING (model_version)

datasets.name: ds_faixas
queryLines: WITH champ AS (SELECT model_version FROM gold_desempenho_modelo WHERE gate_status = 'aprovado' ORDER BY avaliado_em DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT LPAD(CAST(f.faixa AS STRING), 2, '0') AS faixa, ROUND(f.taxa_maus, 4) AS taxa_maus,
ROUND(f.lift, 2) AS lift FROM gold_desempenho_faixas f JOIN champ USING (model_version) ORDER BY f.faixa

datasets.name: ds_ks
queryLines: WITH champ AS (SELECT model_version FROM gold_desempenho_modelo WHERE gate_status = 'aprovado' ORDER BY avaliado_em DESC LIMIT 1), f AS (SELECT x.* FROM gold_desempenho_faixas x JOIN champ USING (model_version))
SELECT LPAD(CAST(faixa AS STRING), 2, '0') AS faixa, '% dos maus capturados' AS serie,
ROUND(pct_maus_acum, 4) AS valor FROM f UNION ALL
SELECT LPAD(CAST(faixa AS STRING), 2, '0'), '% dos bons reprovados', ROUND(pct_bons_acum, 4) FROM f UNION ALL
SELECT LPAD(CAST(faixa AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'KS (diferença)', ROUND(ks, 4) FROM f

datasets.name: ds_cortes
queryLines: WITH champ AS (SELECT model_version FROM gold_desempenho_modelo WHERE gate_status = 'aprovado' ORDER BY avaliado_em DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT ROUND(c.threshold, 3) AS threshold, ROUND(c.pct_reprovados, 3) AS pct_reprovados,
ROUND(c.precisao_maus, 3) AS precisao, ROUND(c.recall_maus, 3) AS recall_maus,
ROUND(c.recall_bons, 3) AS recall_bons, CAST(c.custo_erros AS BIGINT) AS custo_erros_rs,
CASE WHEN c.threshold_escolhido THEN '◀ corte do modelo' ELSE '' END AS observacao
FROM gold_desempenho_cortes c JOIN champ USING (model_version) ORDER BY c.threshold DESC

datasets.name: ds_versoes
queryLines: SELECT CONCAT('v', model_version) AS modelo, ROUND(auc, 3) AS auc, ROUND(ks, 3) AS ks,
ROUND(pr_auc, 3) AS pr_auc, ROUND(threshold, 3) AS threshold, gate_status, gate_falhas, avaliado_em
FROM gold_desempenho_modelo ORDER BY avaliado_em DESC

datasets.name: ds_kpis
queryLines: WITH ult AS (SELECT safra, model_version FROM gold_credit_scores ORDER BY scored_at DESC LIMIT 1), s AS (SELECT g.* FROM gold_credit_scores g JOIN ult USING (safra, model_version))
SELECT FIRST(s.safra) AS safra, CONCAT('v', FIRST(s.model_version)) AS modelo, COUNT(*) AS clientes,
ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.decisao = 'REPROVAR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 4) AS pct_reprovados,
ROUND(AVG(s.score), 0) AS score_medio,
(SELECT ROUND(MAX(r.psi), 4) FROM gold_monitoramento_resumo r JOIN ult u USING (safra, model_version)
WHERE r.variavel = 'score_modelo') AS psi_score,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gold_monitoramento_resumo r JOIN ult u USING (safra, model_version)
WHERE r.variavel <> 'score_modelo') AS variaveis_monitoradas,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gold_monitoramento_resumo r JOIN ult u USING (safra, model_version)
WHERE r.status <> 'estável') AS variaveis_em_alerta
FROM s

datasets.name: ds_status
queryLines: WITH ult AS (SELECT safra, model_version FROM gold_monitoramento_resumo ORDER BY monitored_at DESC LIMIT 1), r AS (SELECT x.* FROM gold_monitoramento_resumo x JOIN ult USING (safra, model_version)
WHERE x.variavel <> 'score_modelo' ORDER BY x.psi DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT CASE WHEN r.status = 'estável'
THEN CONCAT('✅ Todas as variáveis estáveis — maior PSI: ', r.variavel, ' (', FORMAT_NUMBER(r.psi, 4), ')')
ELSE CONCAT('⚠️ Atenção na variável ', r.variavel, ' (PSI ', FORMAT_NUMBER(r.psi, 2), ' — ', r.status, ')')
END AS status FROM r

datasets.name: ds_psi_resumo
queryLines: WITH ult AS (SELECT safra, model_version FROM gold_monitoramento_resumo ORDER BY monitored_at DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT r.variavel, ROUND(r.psi, 4) AS psi, r.status, r.safra, r.model_version
FROM gold_monitoramento_resumo r JOIN ult USING (safra, model_version) ORDER BY r.psi DESC

datasets.name: ds_psi_long
queryLines: WITH ult AS (SELECT safra, model_version FROM gold_monitoramento_resumo ORDER BY monitored_at DESC LIMIT 1), p AS (SELECT x.* FROM gold_monitoramento_psi x JOIN ult USING (safra, model_version))
SELECT variavel, faixa, 'Treino (esperado)' AS base, ROUND(pct_esperado, 4) AS pct FROM p UNION ALL
SELECT variavel, faixa, 'Safra (atual)', ROUND(pct_atual, 4) FROM p

datasets.name: ds_psi_detalhe
queryLines: WITH ult AS (SELECT safra, model_version FROM gold_monitoramento_resumo ORDER BY monitored_at DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT p.variavel, p.faixa, ROUND(p.pct_esperado, 4) AS pct_esperado, ROUND(p.pct_atual, 4) AS pct_atual,
ROUND(p.psi, 5) AS psi FROM gold_monitoramento_psi p JOIN ult USING (safra, model_version)
ORDER BY p.variavel, p.faixa

datasets.name: ds_decisao
queryLines: WITH ult AS (SELECT safra, model_version FROM gold_credit_scores ORDER BY scored_at DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT g.decisao, COUNT(*) AS clientes FROM gold_credit_scores g JOIN ult USING (safra, model_version)
GROUP BY g.decisao

datasets.name: ds_score
queryLines: WITH ult AS (SELECT safra, model_version FROM gold_credit_scores ORDER BY scored_at DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT CAST(FLOOR(g.score / 50) * 50 AS INT) AS faixa_score, g.decisao, COUNT(*) AS clientes
FROM gold_credit_scores g JOIN ult USING (safra, model_version) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: ds_iv
queryLines: WITH ult AS (SELECT model_version FROM gold_credit_scores ORDER BY scored_at DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT b.variavel, ROUND(SUM(b.iv), 4) AS iv FROM gold_bivariadas b JOIN ult USING (model_version)
GROUP BY b.variavel ORDER BY iv DESC

datasets.name: ds_bivariadas
queryLines: WITH ult AS (SELECT model_version FROM gold_credit_scores ORDER BY scored_at DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT b.variavel, b.faixa, b.qtd, ROUND(b.pct_total, 4) AS pct_total, b.evento, b.nao_evento,
ROUND(b.taxa_evento, 4) AS taxa_evento, ROUND(b.odds, 4) AS odds, ROUND(b.woe, 4) AS woe,
ROUND(b.iv, 4) AS iv, ROUND(b.lift, 2) AS lift
FROM gold_bivariadas b JOIN ult USING (model_version) ORDER BY b.variavel, b.faixa
